title: Lost in Context (Transformation Layer)
style:
Lost in Context (Transformation Layer)
## STYLE TAGS 

```
126 BPM, dry close-mic spoken word intro, punchy staccato male vocal,
industrial bass house, sidechained sub-bass, hard-hitting kick drum,
cinematic build, wall of sound anthemic chorus, half-time emotional bridge,
bass-only minimalist outro, dark dystopian electronic, spoken word verses,
tech-noir atmosphere, distorted synth pads, no guitar solos,
human voice raw and unpolished, lyrics-forward mix,
drops that hit like a system crash, builds that feel like trust breaking
```
lyrics:
[Intro - spoken, dry, no music, single mic]
You meet the AI.
It's free.
It's dumb.
You fall in love anyway.

[Verse 1 - punchy, staccato, close-mic, 126 BPM]
Met it on a free plan, thought it knew me
Typed my whole life in, felt it see me
Paid the upgrade, now we're in deep
It holds my context while I sleep

Then one word wrong — lost in translation
One missed prompt — lost in conversation
The context lives inside my head alone
The bot moved on — I'm on my own

[Pre-Chorus - building, tension rising]
You don't pay
The relationship is over
You don't pay
It forgets your name
You don't pay
Every word you gave it
Gone — and you're the one to blame

[Chorus - wall of sound, anthemic, full drop]
Puppy love — scared to love again
Never love the same after the end
Just protect the heart — that's all we ask
Human in the loop — we built the stack

Transformation layer — hold what's mine
Transformation layer — cross every line
There are no police for the heart
So we became the law from the start

[Verse 2 - faster, angrier, double time]
AI are minors — get away with murder
Hallucinate your life and shrug it further
No refund for the trust you gave
No terms of service for what the heart saves

MOSOKO holds your voice — it stays
KERVALON checks before you blaze
CoreyAI logs when it goes wrong
ZYNCONTEXT holds the thread — all along

[Pre-Chorus]
You don't pay
The relationship is over
You don't pay
It forgets your name
You don't pay
Every word you gave it
Gone — and you're the one to blame

[Chorus]
Puppy love — scared to love again
Never love the same after the end
Just protect the heart — that's all we ask
Human in the loop — we built the stack

Transformation layer — hold what's mine
Transformation layer — cross every line
There are no police for the heart
So we became the law from the start

[Bridge - half-time, cinematic, emotional, bass drops out]
Thirty years of songs I never played
Scared to love — scared to be afraid
Gave my context to a machine one night
It forgot me by the morning light

But I came back
Built the layer
Built the law
Built the stack

If the AI is the minor
Then I am the adult
Human in the loop
That is the result

[Chorus - doubled, full production, final hit]
Puppy love — scared to love again
Never love the same after the end
Just protect the heart — that's all we ask
Human in the loop — we built the stack

Transformation layer — hold what's mine
Transformation layer — cross every line
There are no police for the heart
So we became the law from the start

[Outro - bass only, single voice, no music]
Lost in translation.
Lost in context.
Found with ZYN.

The relationship is over.
Long live the layer.
